semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Tohoku Gakuin University conducts research in semiconductor technologies, particularly in thin-film transistors and compound semiconductors, but it is primarily an educational and research institution rather than a direct supplier.
summary: Tohoku Gakuin University's Semiconductor Laboratories focus on advanced research in semiconductor technologies, including glass substrates for thin-film transistors and compound semiconductors for power devices and sensors. Their work aims to innovate in areas such as IoT and flexible electronics through high-performance semiconductor devices.
capabilities: Research on thin-film transistors (TFTs) on glass substrates
Research on power devices using compound semiconductors like ZnO and GaN

regional_presence.Japan: The laboratory is based in Japan and collaborates with local industrial technology centers.
